title: Kanmani Anbudan
description: Anbu is shocked to know about Jeeva's love for Kanmani and shares his grief with Karthi. He rushes to the restaurant, as Jeeva confesses his love, but Kanmani acts distant.

title: Thendrale Mella Pesu
episodeTitle: Viji, Paraman Team Up for Ilamathi
description: Viji and Paraman rushes to the station after learning Ilamathi was falsely arrested. Ilamathi is deeply moved as Paraman stands up for her against Kalamma and Ranjitham.

title: Thaai Maaman
description: Poongodi's function begins as Azhagar reluctantly blesses her with hatred. Meanwhile, Mayandi requests Manjamalai to attend the invitation distribution ceremony.

title: Sindhu Bairavi
description: Sindhu seeks Shyam's help to prove Siva's innocence. Together, they threaten to expose Sneha's past with Shyam unless she withdraws the case and clears Siva's name.

title: Azhagae Azhagu
description: Growing suspicious of her voice notes, Thangaraj inspects Revathi's phone. Elsewhere, Lakshmi erupts in anger as Malar supports Mathi's refusal to wash innerwear clothes.

title: Pandian Stores 2
description: Senthil takes a depressed Saravanan to a doctor and informs Kathir about his state. Later, Saravanan publicly blasts Palanivel for getting involved in Kumar's marriage matters.

title: Ayyanar Thunai
description: Nila consoles a distressed Chozhan after opposing his decision to move away and shares her joy of staying together. Later, Chozhan's brothers rejoice as their family is united.

title: Siragadikka Aasai
description: Chandra worries about Seetha's life with Arun. While Seetha boldly defends her choices, Meena grows anxious over pregnancy complications and the need for surgery.

title: Chinna Marumagal
description: Sethupathi unexpectedly gets possessed by Karuppu God. Through divine prophecy, he reveals Tamizhselvi bears a false allegation and blesses her with hope.

title: Kadhal Kadhal Kadhal
description: Arjun fakes a panic-induced faint before tying the Thaali around Swetha's neck. In a stunning twist, he shocks everyone by tying the Thaali around Madhu's neck instead of Swetha's.

title: Onna Irukka Kaththukanum
description: Arivalagan gets Lakshmi Mess sealed through a food inspection raid.Later, He demands Kandhasamy to fall at his friend's feet while Kumaran begs forgiveness.
